description: Severity-pathway attributable fractions of KA crashes
method: g-computation with survey logistic model A; AF = (observed - counterfactual predicted)/observed; linearised CI; for the fatal outcome only, FARS-scaled = AF x mean annual FARS fatal crashes (or deaths) 2022-2024, assuming the averted fatal crashes carry the average number of deaths per fatal crash; fractions of KA crashes are not scaled
